title: Zinc blood test
what: This blood test shows whether your body has enough zinc.
why: For hair loss, slow wound healing, frequent colds, changes in taste, long-lasting diarrhea, and in children, poor growth.
duration: the blood draw takes a few minutes; results usually come in a few days
tell_doctor: If you take vitamins or supplements with zinc
If you have a bowel condition or had stomach surgery
If you take water pills or hormone pills

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Blood is usually taken in the morning on an empty stomach: 8 to 12 hours without food. Plain water is fine. Check with the lab.

prepare.title: Supplements
prepare.text: Ask your doctor if you should pause zinc supplements before the test.

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: For 24 hours: no alcohol and no hard workouts. Try not to smoke in the morning.

prepare.title: Clothing
prepare.text: A sleeve you can easily roll up above the elbow.

bring: Your referral or list of tests
A list of the vitamins and supplements you take
steps: You sit down and rest your arm on the armrest
A band is tied above your elbow, and you are asked to clench your fist a few times
The skin is wiped with antiseptic
A quick prick. Blood fills the tubes in a few seconds
The needle comes out, and a cotton pad is pressed on the spot
feel: A quick prick, like a pinch
Sometimes slight dizziness. Tell the nurse, and they will help you lie down
after: Press the cotton pad for 3 to 5 minutes
Do not start taking zinc on your own. Your doctor will choose the dose based on the result
red_flags: The puncture site is very swollen, painful, and red

faq.a: Blood zinc changes after meals. In the morning on an empty stomach, the result is more accurate.

faq.q: Can I just start taking zinc without a test?
faq.a: Better not. Too much zinc is harmful too, so your doctor should set the dose and how long to take it.

reminders.text: Zinc test tomorrow. Do not eat after dinner. Water is fine.
